data.message_text: Hob has a single eyelash on his left eye that grows so long it falls down and touches the floor. He has to trim it constantly but one time I saw it when he didnt trim it and it looked crazy. I'm pretty sure the same gene that causes it also gives him the ability to not get hit in video games. But yeah someone should do something about that.
